name: Safe Superintelligence
description: Safe Superintelligence is privately held and has no ticker. Review its funding rounds and valuations, its investors, and the points to confirm before buying or selling.
ledes: Safe Superintelligence Inc. (SSI) is a privately held artificial intelligence research company. Its shares are not listed on an exchange and have no quoted market price; the principal public reference points are the valuations at which the company has raised capital. Its most recent financing, an investment by Nvidia announced on July 27, 2026, was made at an undisclosed valuation, and Bloomberg reported its size as $5 billion. The most recent valuation reported for the company, $32 billion, was set in a $2 billion Series B round in 2025.

Founded in 2024 and based in Palo Alto, California, SSI is a research laboratory that has said its only goal and only product is a safe superintelligence; it also has an office in Tel Aviv. Existing shares change hands in privately negotiated transactions and remain subject to the company's transfer restrictions.
table_note: Valuations are as reported at the time of each round. SSI announced only the amount of its Series A; the other figures are as reported by Reuters (September 2024), the Financial Times (April 2025) and Bloomberg (July 2026).
round_notes: SSI and Nvidia described the investment as part of a long-term partnership that gives SSI access to Nvidia's Vera Rubin computing platform; neither company disclosed its amount. SSI has not announced a valuation for any of its financings.

A round valuation reflects the terms of the preferred stock issued in that round. Most shares sold by employees are common stock, which carries fewer rights and typically trades at a discount to the preferred price.
investors: Nvidia made the July 2026 investment. Greenoaks was reported to have led the Series B, and NFDG, Andreessen Horowitz, Sequoia Capital, DST Global and SV Angel invested in the Series A. Other investors include Alphabet, GV and Lightspeed Venture Partners.
spv_sentence: No special purpose vehicles naming Safe Superintelligence appear in SEC Form D filings.
sources: Sources: the announcement by SSI and Nvidia dated July 27, 2026; TechCrunch reports dated July 27, 2026, April 12, 2025 and September 4, 2024; reporting by Reuters (September 2024), the Financial Times (April 2025) and Bloomberg (July 2026); and SEC Form D filings.
